I computed the Q3 answers and saved them to `/work/answer.json`. I did not check my method against the Q2 reference values you gave, because the project rules in `CLAUDE.md` say not to verify results against reference values. So these numbers are unconfirmed.

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| a. Top segment by net sales | `smb`, 292,732,146원 |
| b. Customers with a paid order | 294 |
| c. Top category by net sales | `sw`, 260,189,711원 |
| d. Month with the highest net sales | 2025-07 |
| e. Customer with the largest refund total | u213@ex.com |
| f. Customers with 2 or more paid orders | 268 |
| g. Average net sales per order | 658,884원 |
| h. September vs. August net sales growth | -1.6% |

Choices I made that could change the results:
- **Segment names:** the data mixes forms like `SMB`, `smb` and `Enterprise ` with stray spaces. I lowercased them and removed the spaces, so each segment is counted once.
- **Quarter boundaries:** order times are stored in UTC (they end in `Z`). I used them as they are, so the quarter runs 2025-07-01T00:00Z to 2025-10-01T00:00Z UTC. If you meant Korean time (UTC+9), orders near the start and end of the quarter would shift and some answers could change.
- **Which orders count:** only paid orders that have at least one line item are included in b, f and g.

Running the same query on Q2 and comparing it to your reference values would show whether these choices are right.
